blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Celo block 74313815 (2026-08-08T18:42:53Z), the sole tracked AUDm deployment 0x7175504c455076f15c04a2f90a8e352281f492f9 returned owner() = 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147, broker() = 0x777a8255ca72412f0d706dc03c9d1987306b4cad, validators() = 0xaeb865bca93ddc8f47b8e29f40c5399ce34d0c58, and exchange() = zero. Its EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots still resolved to verified StableTokenV2 0x434563b0604be100f04b7ae485bcafe3c9d8850e and the Mento Timelock. The verified implementation exposes ordinary transfer/transferFrom, permissioned mint, broker/exchange-scoped burn, and Celo-VM-only gas debiting; it has no blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, arbitrary-holder burn, or transfer-hook restriction. Mento's official materials describe direct protocol distribution and community governance with no single controlling entity, not a separate issuer freeze power. Direct holder freeze is therefore false; reserve-leg censorship and the timelocked upgrade path remain measured upstream and restrictability risks.

oracleRisk.summary: At Celo block 78986505, AUDm's Broker/BiPoolManager USDm/AUDm ConstantSum exchange 0xd580d237231109e6a96d67d82450611c610a805a26660c90281bdc0cd04a95c7 uses AUD/USD feed 0x646bd504c3864ea5b8a6b6d25743721f61864a07, one ChainlinkRelayerV1 reporter 0xa8869bb55d1082d12c8f993a56ce8d050551a3d9, and one configured Chainlink aggregator 0xf2bd4faa89f5a360cdf118bccd183307fdbcb6f5. getRates and medianRate agree on 693160000000000000000000/1e24; medianTimestamp is 1790887224. Effective report expiry and bucket reset are 360 seconds, minimumReports is 1, and spread is 0.15%. MedianDeltaBreaker is enabled at 4% with a 900-second reset cooldown; ValueDeltaBreaker is disabled. The sorted-list median of one relayer is not independent medianization or failover. Stale reports invalidate ConstantSum quotes; BreakerBox suspends execution rather than substituting a second source. This evidenced single-live-source topology retains the existing Mento single-source-or-laggy convention; it does not assert the pinned report was stale.

branchApplicability.rationale: AUDm is explicitly reserve-backed in the pinned issuer configuration, not one of the GBPm/CHFm/JPYm CDP assets. The enumerated pinned Broker mint/burn exchange has external price authority but no borrower-specific liquidation engine. Score this authority as coin-price-feed/top-level-only; branch rows and liquidationDelaySec are not applicable. A 900-second breaker reset cooldown or 360-second report expiry is not a liquidation delay. This review covers canonical Celo exchange pricing and does not classify separate bridge control or remote-chain liquidity.
